subject: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth

Hi Emma,

Following our commercial call last week, attaching a proposal for how Redwood would operationalize LumenHealth's annual committed spend so your procurement and finance teams have a clear invoice + drawdown cadence. High-level proposal in the attachment (Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx).

Topline suggested approach: 
- Invoice cadence: quarterly invoices (advance) with monthly drawdown sub-ledger entries to reflect consumption; this keeps bank transfers smaller while keeping bookkeeping alignment.
- Drawdown tracking: we provide a rolling CSV export for your ledger team and a monthly reconciliation report.
- VAT handling: Redwood will issue invoices from the Redwood US entity by default; if you need EU VAT treatment we can route via our EU entity (need your VAT ID and invoicing remit instructions).

Ask: can procurement confirm (a) target invoice frequency (quarterly vs monthly advance), (b) the contact for PO issuance and purchase order number, and (c) any VAT/entity preference? If OK we can start with a DocuSign for the order form and schedule the first invoice for May 1.

I've CC'd Marcus (ops) and Karthik (pricing/legal touch) to help scope the remittance and tax details.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head, Billing & Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx

From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth

Thanks Kimberly — received. A couple of clarifying points from procurement (procurement@lumenhealth.com):

1) PO: we will issue a single annual PO for the committed amount but prefer monthly invoices (for cashflow reporting) that net against the PO. PO number will be 45321 — see attached PO_45321.pdf.
2) VAT: LumenHealth will require EU-style VAT evidence if invoices are routed to our EU subsidiary; otherwise US invoices (no VAT) are fine. We can provide VAT ID if Redwood needs to route through its EU entity.
3) Remittance: our treasury team prefers bank transfers with an IBAN reference on the invoice. Can you provide sample remittance instructions and a sample invoice?

Couple of asks for your side: sample invoice that shows the PO reference and the preferred description line (please use: "Redwood Inference - Annual Capacity Commitment - LumenHealth"). Also confirm whether Redwood can provide a monthly drawdown CSV so our AP system can consume it automatically.

Best,
Emma Jenkins
Director, Procurement
LumenHealth

Attachment: PO_45321.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth

Emma — thanks for the quick turn. Quick responses inline: 

- PO handling: single annual PO + monthly invoice netting is fine. We’ll issue monthly invoices that reference PO 45321 and include line-level consumption details.
- Drawdown CSV: yes — we’ll deliver a machine-friendly CSV on the 3rd business day each month with columns: invoice_date, invoice_number, po_number, drawdown_amount, remaining_commit_balance, sku_tag, region. We can also support a SFTP drop or secure S3 presigned URL each month if preferred.
- Sample remittance: see sample attached (Sample_Invoice_Redwood_2027Q1.pdf) — that PDF shows our preferred bank wire fields; we can customize for IBAN routing if you’ll be paying via an EU bank.
- VAT routing: if you provide the VAT ID and want EU treatment, we’ll switch issuing entity and rerun invoice samples for your review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood to upload the first monthly invoice sample and the drawdown CSV template to DocuSign/HubSpot (DocuSign link below).
2) Lumen to confirm PO number (confirmed 45321) and provide VAT ID if EU routing required.
3) Redwood to prepare DocuSign order form + schedule initial invoice for May 1 and monthly drawdown CSV on June 3 for May consumption.

DocuSign (order form draft): https://redwood.docusign.com/LH-45321
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890

Attaching the CSV template (embedded in Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx) for your finance team to preview.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx, Sample_Invoice_Redwood_2027Q1.pdf

From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 2:32 PM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emma — thanks for the quick turn. Quick responses inline:
> 
> - PO handling: single annual PO + monthly invoice netting is fine. We’ll issue monthly invoices that reference PO 45321 and include line-level consumption details.
> - Drawdown CSV: yes — we’ll deliver a machine-friendly CSV on the 3rd business day each month with columns: invoice_date, invoice_number, po_number, drawdown_amount, remaining_commit_balance, sku_tag, region.
> 
That format looks good.

Confirming: we will provide the VAT ID if we route to EU — for now route invoices from Redwood US entity. We will pay by wire to the US account in the sample remittance; treasury wants an IBAN-equivalent reference field included in the PDF for their payment engine, but they can map the fields.

We can accept the monthly CSV via SFTP. Please share hostname + user instructions. Also can you include a brief change log column in the CSV so our AP can detect alterations between months?

If you can update the schedule to show initial invoice date May 1, monthly CSV deliverable June 3, and first reconciliation call week of June 7, we can approve and proceed to signature.

Best,
Emma

Attachment: PO_45321.pdf (again)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend — proposed invoicing cadence & drawdown tracking for LumenHealth

Emma — great, thanks for the confirmations. Summarizing actions and timeline so we have alignment: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Update invoice schedule to monthly invoice issuance (reference PO 45321) and keep an annual PO on file. Deliverable: updated XLSX with CSV template and change_log column included. (owner: Marcus) — due Thu, Apr 22.
- Provision SFTP credentials and wiring instruction variant for IBAN mapping for LumenHealth treasury. (owner: Finance Ops) — due Fri, Apr 23.
- Draft DocuSign order form with the agreed cadence and sample invoice attached; send to Emma for signature. (owner: Legal/RevOps) — target Mon, Apr 26.
- First invoice issuance: May 1 (monthly invoice referencing PO 45321).
- Monthly drawdown CSV delivery schedule: deliver on the 3rd business day following the invoice month (first deliverable June 3 for May).

Action items (LumenHealth):
- Confirm VAT ID if EU entity routing required (Emma/procurement).
- Treasury to confirm wire/IBAN mapping field and accept sample invoice.
- Sign DocuSign order form when received.

Other notes: deal id LH-2027-045321; Redwood will include PO reference on all invoice PDFs and embed the drawdown CSV link in the invoice metadata. We’ll include a brief change_log column as requested.

Attachments we'll send in follow-up: updated Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v2.xlsx (includes CSV template + sample invoice), SFTP_Instructions.txt

Thanks — loop back if anything needs immediate modification.

Kimberly Park
Head, Billing & Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Lumen_Invoice_Schedule_v2.xlsx, SFTP_Instructions.txt
